situation_context.space_character: large empty outdoor area between building and playground

observation: children pass through the area but do not linger
no shade, no enclosure, no narrative
diagnosis: no emotional anchor connecting building, children, and outdoor activity

decision.problem: the space lacks a visual and emotional anchor
decision.strategy: build a single thematically anchored experience node

principle: create one memorable experience node before adding secondary facilities
boundary: do not apply when budget cannot support a meaningful experience node
do not apply when existing space already lacks basic safety functions
